entities.summary: The Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters is a learned society based in Oslo, Norway. Its purpose is to support the advancement of science and scholarship in Norway. Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters is a academy of sciences in Oslo, established in 1857-05-03. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
